scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/backend && npm run build -w packages/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/frontend && npm run test -w packages/backend
scripts.lint: echo 'Lint is not set up yet: there is no ESLint config file in this repo and @typescript-eslint/parser is not installed, so ESLint cannot read TypeScript. Use npm run typecheck instead. To enable real linting: npm i -D @typescript-eslint/parser @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin, commit the updated package-lock.json, add an .eslintrc.json, then run the lint:eslint script.'
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/backend/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/frontend/tsconfig.json
